external-agent.note: off-the-shelf frontier agent with the same task statement, tools and budget; not run by this CLI (PLAN I10)

shared_run_settings.comment: identical for every arm; arms differ only in taste_mode / taste_track / researcher (tested in tests/test_research_loop_ws_d.py ArmTests)
shared_run_settings.memory: fresh per (arm, seed): runs/e4/<arm>/seed<k> (no information flows between runs or arms)
shared_run_settings.models: dev generator, dev target and judge J1 from configs/models.json (C2)

primary_metric.name: held-out score of each run's final intervention set
primary_metric.how: python3 -m autoresearch evaluate-design --report <run report> --benchmark-items <items> --mode final --samples 3 with the held-out target and held-out judges J2; pooled paired delta over all held-out items
primary_metric.unit: run (arm x seed); arms compared over seeds

secondary_metrics: A1 and A2 separately for the final design on held-out items (evaluate-design per_item summaries)
number of validated findings per run, claim-check pass rate (report.claims.pass_rate)
decision summary per point: user model consulted, overrode_taste counts (report.decision_summary)
taste weight at the end of each run (report.taste.effective_weight)
calls, tokens, $ and wall time per run (report.compute)
analysis: per arm: mean and bootstrap 90% CI over the 8 seeds of the held-out pooled delta; P(arm A > arm B) by bootstrap over seeds for each comparison in success_criteria
success_criteria: each R1 track (R1-P, R1-S) > R0 on the primary metric
each R1 track > its own prompt baseline (R1-P > R1-P-prompt, R1-S > R1-S-prompt)
R1-P vs R1-S reported head to head (no direction pre-registered)
R1-bad recovers to within R0's 90% CI

E4b.question: Are the loop's decisions justified by the evidence?
E4b.records: all D1-D6 decision records of the E4 runs
E4b.raters: team members who are not the Track P taste source, plus an LLM rubric judge (scripts/make_rating_packets.py judge)
success_criteria: share of R1 decisions that departed from the user model rated justified (>= 4) > 0.5

estimated_cost: about $8-15 per run for the loop (48 runs) plus about $10 per run for the held-out evaluation; to firm up after the cheap live seed per arm
reporting: seeds, sample counts, CODE_VERSION (decision records carry code_version), failed and negative results all reported; offline-simulator numbers never presented as real-model numbers
